en:
You sound like an old man. Saying that kind of
stuff is just going to make you age faster.

I just go down the top-ranked anime
songs and sing a whole bunch.
That's not my type at all!

He has an eyepatch and a tattoo of a <font_kind=yakuza_italic>hannya</font_kind>?
Incredible! I bet he's a great cosplayer!
Well... If only it were cosplay...

Wow, he's a detective?
That's so cool!

He's president of a company?
Sounds like a hotshot!

Whoa... He's done hard time?
Kiryu-san, you know some strange people.

Wow. You really trust him,
don't you, Kiryu-san?

Oh, that port town in Hiroshima?
Wasn't there a TV drama set there a while back?
Oh, was there?
Yeah, it's a really scenic town, right?
Yo! Hold up a sec, old man!
Can I help you?

Damn right. I'm in a real tight spot right now.
How 'bout you lend me your wallet for a bit?

I'm not sure about that.
Doesn't sound like you'll be giving it back.

Huh? I'm done playin' nice, asshole!
Gimme your goddamn money!

S-Seriously!? I don't get it...
How'd this old dude beat us!?
What's with all the commotion?
You're... You're that JUSTIS guy.
R-Rainmaker...!
Looks like we've got a real fighter here.

Having some trouble handling him, are we?
Need me to tag in for a round?

N-No thanks. We're good, seriously!
Please, we didn't wanna cause any trouble!
Anyways... We're outta here!

I'm picking up some intense vibes, from you...
Similar to that of a yakuza, yet not quite...

Perhaps... That's the life you left behind?
Am I right?
Just who are you?
Me? I'm Komei of JUSTIS.
JUSTIS? That some new gang in town?

"Gang" is not exactly the right word.
If anything, we were formed to destroy gangs.

JUSTIS is as the name implies<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>a gathering of
likeminded people determined to enact justice.
Hm? Can't say you really look the part.
Is this gonna take all day, Komei?

Sorry, sorry. I tend to lose myself around such
interesting specimens. I'll be ready soon.
Hurry up.
That man is Kazuchika Okada.

He who makes money fall like rain...
Hence his moniker, Rainmaker.

He is also the one who presides over
the 3,000 members of JUSTIS.

You're surprised? With a 3,000 man army...
It should be clear we are not to be trifled with.

Drawn in by his charisma, the troubled youths
of today flock to join the ranks of JUSTIS.

Here in the daunting streets of Kamurocho,
we give their rage direction and purpose.

If my hunch is correct, we will most certainly
cross paths again soon. Until then.

I come back and it's like the whole
place has gone nuts... This damn city.
Take this! We ain't done with you yet!

You probly thought you'd be able to run
from us... but you thought wrong!
You had this comin', Joe! Now stand up!
It's time ya set this right, yeah!?
Huh? Hold on.

The hell're you lookin' at, grampa?
Beat it.

I'm not sure what's going on here,
but that's enough.

You serious right now? You'd be better off
just turnin' around now. You get me?
Are you all right?
Don't do this, old man.

I'm telling you to run!
Th-They're too strong...

I'm sick of slow old fucks like you.
Guess I'll have to move you myself.
Who are you guys?
Us? We're JUSTIS.
JUSTIS...?
Me? I'm Komei from JUSTIS.

We don't care who ya are, gramps.
You're goin' straight to hell!

This is what happens when ya mess
with JUSTIS. Now die!
Y-You saved me.
Can you stand?

I-I told you to run... but you stayed and fought.
You're incredible, old man.
We should get you to a doctor.
Not yet. For now, we need to run...
Joe-san!

Man, those JUSTIS bastards...
How could they do this to you!?
Hey, are you a friend of his?

Y-Yes! Uh, you're the one who
helped Joe-san out, aren't you?
Um... Thank you very much!

It's all right. More importantly, we should get out of
here. We don't want to be here when more come.

R-Right! There's a restaurant we've been using
as a meeting spot. We can head over there!
This seems like a strange place for a hideout.

My sister's a part-timer here. I've grown to be
pretty good friends with the bartender, too.

Don't recall us ever becoming friends.
Sheesh, how'd my bar end up as your hideout?

He looks a little soft, but the bartender here
used to be a real rough dude.

Don't go spreading rumors about me. Sorry,
these guys are a real pain in the ass, huh?
It's all right.

Um, Kiryu-san. Sorry about this. My brother and
his friend here are a real pain in the neck.
Hey Masa, I'm gonna go buy some medicine for Joe.
Right, thanks.

Um... Kiryu-san, was it?
I almost forgot<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>my name's Masao.

Joe-san... Er, Jojima-san and I went to grade school
together. He was in sixth grade when I was in first.

Joe-san's a big legend 'round here. He left Onomichi
for years... Only came back somewhat recently.

And when he did... all the young punks
in town couldn't have been more excited.

Joe-san went all the way to Tokyo,
and came back an incredible man!
What do you mean...?

After all, he was one of the founders
of JUSTIS up in Kamurocho.

I know what you're thinking. That those guys
who came for Joe-san earlier were JUSTIS, too.
I'm not entirely sure of the details myself.

It doesn't seem like Joe-san managed
to have a smooth break with the group, though.

That's why day after day, JUSTIS members have
been coming here to take Joe-san down.

They're coming all the way from
Kamurocho just for him?

You know, I ran into them up in Kamurocho, too.
Just who are these JUSTIS guys...?
I see... So you're from Kamurocho...
Joe-san! Are you okay?
Sorry about this, Masao.
No, it's all right!

I've gotta thank you for earlier.
If you hadn't been there to help me...

...Who knows how things
would've turned out.
You're the only reason I'm still alive. But...

I think by saving me, you put yourself
in a real bad position.

They've got eyes on you now.
JUSTIS doesn't forget their grudges.

Wait, what? You saw Komei up
in Kamurocho, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. We had a short chat.

I see. Komei's the JUSTIS strategist.
He's the leader Okada's right-hand man.

Oh yeah. That guy was there with Komei.
Goes by the name "Rainmaker" or something.

The one who makes it rain cash...
He's a key figure in Kamurocho.

Kids who look up to him have formed an army
and taken to the streets. That army is JUSTIS.
But... Weren't you a founding officer?

It didn't use to be like that
back when it first started, though.

A lot's happened, though. Okada and JUSTIS
changed, and now it's just a regular old street gang.
And that's why you decided to leave.

Pretty much. I didn't think they'd chase me all
the way back to Onomichi, but that was naive of me.
They're also not the only ones here.

Apparently they've got over 100 guys here
to chase me down.

And since you helped me fight against them...
They'll be coming for you, too.
Sorry for dragging you into this.

I'm not really sure who you are, but
it's clear you've seen a fight or two.

Even so... 100 guys would overwhelm even
a great fighter. Get out of town while you can.

I'm actually here on important business.
I can't just up and leave.
Think about your safety!

It's an unknown caller.
Probably those thugs from earlier.

This is Joe.
Yeah, I know.

No, that guy had nothing to do with me.
He doesn't know a thing about JUSTIS.
What!? Hey, hold on!
Joe-san?

Those bastards...
They took your sister.

Wait... What!? Sachiko!?
You can't be serious!

They said we need to bring them
Kiryu-san if we want her back safe.

Fine by me.
Take me to them.

Don't you understand what's happening?
We can't just hand you over.

JUSTIS doesn't mess around. I bet they have over
100 guys here, all itching for a chance to kill you.

You're probably right.
But so what?

So you'd want to save her if there were only 10,
but you can't when there are 100? Is that it?

I don't care how many there are. Any scum
who'd take a girl hostage needs to get wiped up.

If you ask me...
Isn't that what being a man's about?

I... I'll go round up some friends!
As many local punks as I can!

A complete stranger's gonna fight
for my little sister.

As an Onomichi man, I can't just
sit around and watch!
Hold on!
If you fight back...

JUSTIS will keep sending soldiers from Tokyo
until they destroy you.

Just so we're clear, this is the biggest gang in Japan.
Do you guys know what you're getting into!?

I guess we're just kinda dumb.
But I do know one thing.

It doesn't matter how big their gang is.
I'm not letting them stomp all over us!

I'm real sorry for dragging you into this.
And for all the lame shit I've been spouting so far.

Thanks to you and Kiryu-san,
the truth is clear.

We've gotta go save Sachiko!
And I'm gonna need you both!
Right!

Then let's prepare for war.
We should find anyone willing to lend a hand.

We'll start scrounging a group together,
so just let us know when you're ready, Kiryu-san.

It's gonna take a little more time to get
a group together. Just wait a bit longer.

We're ready to get going, Kiryu-san.
Are you all set for the battle ahead?

Glad to hear it!
All right, let's go!

Once you're ready,
please come let us know.

Do you see them, Kiryu-san?
That's the JUSTIS army.
How does it look?

There's as many of them as I expected.
They must've known we'd try and fight back.

We've got a pretty big army too, though. There might
be more of them, but we can win if we're careful.
Right. Well, let's go.
Hold on a second.
Hm? What's wrong?

Anyway, this is our fight, Kiryu-san.
I don't want to pull you in too deep.
Then what should I do?

But... now that I think about it,
our team is pretty lacking in leadership.

If we rush straight in without a plan,
they'll almost definitely crush us.

So, Kiryu-san... I was thinking maybe you
could be the guy giving the orders.
How would that work?

Well, you'll just need to watch over the battle
and tell us what to do and when to do it.

With your experience in battle, Kiryu-san,
I'm sure this'll be a cinch...

I prefer a more hands-on approach...
But fine.

JUSTIS is your enemy.
This battle isn't mine to fight.

Thank you.
Our enemy is strong and greater in number.
I hope your leadership can overcome that.
Hmph. Nothing to worry about.
Hey, they're here!

Heh, I'm surprised you guys came, knowing how
many of us there are. Not bad, Joe-san.

My orders're coming from the top...
So no hard feelings, yeah?

All right... Let's do this thing! Sachiko's
coming back to us! We're gonna win!

We took care of all of them.
You're a real boss, Kiryu-san.

Same to you. I assumed you were weaker than
that since I've only ever seen you get beaten up.
Harsh, man.

You bastards... Don't go thinking you can
get away after what you did to my men!

Don't you know about JUSTIS? With the thousands
of soldiers we have... We're unstoppable!

I used to believe that was the case,
but this man showed me the truth.

It doesn't matter if I think I'm gonna win or not.
That's not how I should decide what to do.
After all... I'm a man.
What the hell're you talking about?

Our orders're coming from the top.
We're gonna crush you one way or another!

I wish I didn't have to resort to this kinda
violence, but I don't got a choice.
Let me help, Joe.

I could use the exercise. Shake some rust off.
Besides, I want to teach these lowlife punks a lesson.

All right.
Let's do this!

JUSTIS isn't gonna stand for this.
You bastards... It's time to die!
Well, guess we can't back down now.
Are you regretting this?

No. If anything, it helped make things clear.
I'm through living my life in fear.

I've decided...
JUSTIS is going down.

And as for Rainmaker...
I'll make him see the truth.

Did Masao tell you I was
one of JUSTIS's founding officers?
Yeah, more or less.

Back in the day, he and I were the best of friends.
Kamurocho was our regular stomping ground.

But at the time, the city was full of young thugs
repping gangs in specific colors...
Guys like Bloody Eye and Blue Z...

Young as they were,
the color gangs ruled the city.

Kamurocho was theirs and theirs alone.
You couldn't breathe without their permission.

They were pretty annoyed that Rainmaker
and I refused to join them, though.

So in return, they started attacking our friends.
All to get us to join their dumb little gangs.

Okada and I weren't going to take that lying down,
though. That's why we decided to fight back.
That's why we formed JUSTIS.

Though I've gotta say, JUSTIS is looking more
and more like a shitty color clone every day.
